newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end lower, hurt by Nomura, tech sales.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end lower, hurt by Nomura, tech sales.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended moderately lower on Monday, hurt by a spate of bad news for Japan's biggest broker Nomura Securities Co Ltd and uncertainty over the country's financial reforms, brokers said.
Some also attributed the fall to technical reasons, prompted by sales in futures contracts ahead of the March options and futures settlement later this week.
The Nikkei 225 average lost 84.85 points or 0.47 percent to 18,113.89. Its March futures slipped 140 points to 18,080 and June 150 to 18,050.
